title: I’m making a match-3 roguelite called Crownfall, would love some honest playtest feedback
author: pixels_that
selftext:
Hey everyone! I’m making **Crownfall**, a tactical match-3 roguelite designed for mobile but I may plan on doing a steam release if its popular. Match jewels to attack, defend, heal, and build your way toward the Crown Dragon.

For transparency, I used **GPT-5.6 Sol and Opus 5 to help write the code**. Art was done by pixellab. 

It’s currently a free browser playtest, and I’d especially love feedback from people trying it on their phones and computers. 

[Try Crownfall here](https://xedd.itch.io/crownfall): portrait mode recommended. Please mention your phone and browser if something breaks. Thanks for trying it!

comments.author: Valuable_Basil9755
comments.body:
Heya, your game caught my eye, so I played a bit on a Galaxy A21s.  
I like the idea and the execution is neat!  
Here is a short collection of thoughts for the game. I tried 1 run as Knight and 1 Mage.



Positive:  
1. I like the combination of systems, where you change between abilities and matching.  
2. The map and polish was surprisingly high, with the VFX and general layout. Good job!  
3. The runs are challenging!  
4. The tapping to inspect and clicking UX feels very nice.  
5. The artwork is coherent, the general aesthethic feels quite solid  
6. The map and tutorial section are a nice touch!  
7. The arcade like interactions with the slot field are nice, exploding a big area and or immediately blasting away a row feel great.  
8. The interactions and effects with the slots (cursed, goo, lock) are very cool, I like them!  
9. Cascading combos with the increasing damage feels very smooth.



Improvement Ideas:  
1. The UI feels cluttered with a lot of text, most of which is either redundant or meaningless. Abilities are very wordy, too. Maybe keep these descriptions more concise, like removing the description on what they would do when executing them in this fight, because the player can just figure that out themselves? The fight screen itself has these (IMO unnecessary) text information, which could easily be encoded in icons:  
\-- Difficulty level "Standard",  
\-- Turn # (does that one even matter?)  
\-- Row 1/12 (is that information necessary? Otherwise, simply have an icon to look at the map like in STS if that is important)  
\-- Gold (could be an icon)  
\-- Name of mob and intent are buttons, would be easier to show these information when clicking on them maybe  
\-- The log on top of the match board has "log like information" which are currently already represented by the VFX.  
\-- I don't understand the mage's "detonate" button on top of the match field.  
\-- The events are very wordy. Having both a description, a dialogue and then the choices feels a lot. The tags such as "Gamble" or "Certain" are not necessary. The choices are often connected to random outcomes, which removes some agency from my decisions. Some simpler, clearer designs for each event would be better.   
2. Clicking on the icons on the map makes a menu pop up, with the only option being "Travel". It feels redundant, would be better to immediately go there.  
3. There are a little too many systems. As far as I understood, overload immediately allows you to use an ability, and the "staggered" (the red bar next to it with some number) does extra stats for it...? I'm not sure what exactly it did, I just kept clicking it lol. Overload should maybe be more difficult to reach, but the overall idea works.  
4. Upgrade paths are very simple and happen too quickly. I had all abilities maxed out as the Knight in Act 3/5. I miss some customization that really fulfills a specific fantasy. The items add very little, generic stats, and the upgrades all have downsides, which doesn't really excite to play. The items having only low flat values makes visiting shops a meh experience, since you can only spend your money on these boring things.  
5. Enemies show their intent, but I had some issues seeing how much damage a monster really does, because the abilities deal damage on top of the base damage? A summed up, easy number would be nice.  
6. There is very little sense of actual progression within a run. The fixed upgrade slots feel a little meh, because they are very random and you can't really build "around" them to reach a certain power fantasy.  
7. Often in fights, I just find myself to spam all my abilities at the beginning to kill an enemy quickly, and then only focus on the match board to match and get some resources. These systems feel disconnected in that way. Are the abilities the main focus of the game, or just the cherry on top, like "ultimate abilities"? As far as I can tell, the game wants to be a "match-3" first, but the current balance tends players to just focus on getting through a combat quickly with effects that give you a full resource charge at the beginning.



Bugs:  
\- Scrolling inside the hero selection menu doesn't work.  
\- In events, there often is the text "Start with X each". Are there icons missing or something? Or what does this information mean?  
\- On my phone, the labels are often too long for the button text in the ability descriptions.  
\- Either the mage is incredibly OP or the mechanic is buggy, but you can simply draw lines on health tiles and immediately heal to full with ridiculous match combos. My first boss fight as mage took 3 turns before the boss could do anything, because the damage on the first spell is too damn high lol

Very nice game though! Don't be scared of all the improvement ideas I listed, I still enjoyed it and spent like an hour playing the game. It is very fun core concept and has a surprising amount of polish and enjoyment to it!

replies.author: pixels_that
replies.body:
Wow thank you so much. I’m glad you enjoyed it. I also appreciate your time for testing it and the feedback.

Yeah im gonna try to cutdown on the UI clutter.  
Ill probably remove the difficulty  
The turn doesn’t matter but i would like to do a way to integrate where you need to finish in a certain amount  
Yeah i agree with all the UI.

Im going to change up the gameplay for the mage. Its supposed to be a sequence cast like u have to put a sequence of jewels in order to cast that spell. Thank you again. I will let you know once ive updated it
